name: Batting order and role-aware AI: usual XI in batting order, pace/spin-aware bowling
message: AI plays its usual XI in batting order; bowlers bat down the order; pace/spin-aware bowling

ops.find:
fun selectNextBatsman(available: List<Player>, situationalBias: Double): Player? =
        if (abs(situationalBias) >= 0.3) available.maxByOrNull { it.battingRating } else available.firstOrNull()
